name: @repo/error-reporting-core
description: Dual-runtime / Workers-safe error-reporting port. Holds the ErrorReportingAdapter interface, the runtime-agnostic NoOpAdapter, and resolveErrorReportingConfig (the self-host / no-op toggle that reads the vendor-neutral ERROR_REPORTING_* env vars and falls back to the legacy BetterStack DSN). Pure, runtime-agnostic code — no Node built-ins, no SDK imports — so it bundles into both the Cloudflare Workers gateway and the Next.js dashboard. The Sentry-backed adapter bindings live in each app.
